normalization_rules.rule_1: Direct mapping of core identity fields: registry_id <- id, name <- name, description <- description.
normalization_rules.rule_2: Separation of endpoints: url <- url, well_known_uri <- wellKnownURI.
normalization_rules.rule_3: Protocol standardization: protocol_version <- protocolVersion, version <- version.
normalization_rules.rule_4: Grouping of quality/operational signals: health <- {is_healthy, uptime_percentage, avg_response_time_ms, last_health_check}, conformance <- {conformance, conformance_errors}.
normalization_rules.rule_5: No invented fields: supported_interfaces populated as null because API uses top-level 'url' rather than nested 'supportedInterfaces' array.
normalization_rules.rule_6: Zero truncation of nested objects: capabilities, skills, security, and securitySchemes preserved intact.
